title: DelegateCapsuleArgs
description: Fixed parent-agent tool envelope. output_example is prompt guidance, never parsed or compiled into a result schema.

capsule.description: Self-contained task contract: goal, cwd/input files or sources to explore, requirements and acceptance checks, allowed edits/commands, stop conditions, and required report fields/artifact paths. Include needed context; the worker cannot see the parent conversation.

output_example.description: Illustrative result format (JSON, table, list, or prose), passed unchanged to Flash; not a schema or an answer to copy. Show the evidence and artifact fields you need.

timeout_s.description: Optional positive deadline in seconds, including startup and result preparation; overrides the configured default (300s unless changed).
